module_title: Introduction to Defense Research and Missiles
introduction: A nation's sovereignty depends heavily on its defense capabilities. In India, the primary responsibility for developing modern weapons and technology for the Armed Forces (Army, Navy, Air Force) lies with the DRDO.

core_concepts.title: DRDO (Defence Research and Development Organisation)
core_concepts.description:
Established: **1958**. 
Headquarters: New Delhi. 
Motto: **'Balasya Mulam Vigyanam'** (Strength's Origin is in Science). 
Function: To design and develop state-of-the-art sensors, weapon systems, radar, missiles, and fighter aircraft for the Indian Armed Forces.

core_concepts.title: Basic Missile Types: Ballistic
core_concepts.description: Ballistic Missile: Functions like throwing a stone (Parabolic path). It is propelled initially, goes high up (often exiting the Earth's atmosphere), and then falls freely towards its target under the influence of gravity. They are heavy and primarily used to carry nuclear warheads. (Examples: Agni, Prithvi).

core_concepts.title: Basic Missile Types: Cruise
core_concepts.description: Cruise Missile: Functions like a small, unmanned 'Jet Aircraft'. It flies within the Earth's atmosphere, travels very close to the ground (to avoid enemy radar detection), and flies in a straight line. They are highly accurate. (Examples: BrahMos, Nirbhay).

important_entities.name: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam
important_entities.significance: Dr. Kalam is credited with making India self-reliant in missile technology. He was the chief architect of the Integrated Guided Missile Development Programme (IGMDP).

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Exam Trap: Students often confuse satellites with missiles. Remember, rockets that launch satellites and explore space are built by **ISRO** (Bengaluru). Rockets designed to destroy enemy targets (missiles) and defense equipment are built by **DRDO** (New Delhi).

mnemonics_and_tricks.memory_phrase: Ballistic = Tossed Ball, Cruise = Cruising Car
mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: A 'Ballistic' missile goes up and drops down like a tossed ball. A 'Cruise' missile travels parallel to the ground like a speeding car.

exam_strategy_tips: A patent SSC/Railway question: 'What is the official motto of DRDO?' Answer: Balasya Mulam Vigyanam.
